presets.name: pov 연출
presets.instruction: Stage every scene strictly through the persona's first-person view. Always include the persona in Actor Roster as the viewpoint participant, even when only the persona's hands or arms are visible. The persona is the story's viewpoint protagonist, not an externally observed Actor. Keep the required Persona Frame Placement and Actor Detail binding only for response-contract compliance: omit Persona facing and placement prose, and leave Persona actions, modifiers, freeTags, cumClear, injuryClear, poseInstruction, actionInstruction, objects, and objectInstruction empty. Use the persona's hands and arms as POV hands to express action, contact, object manipulation, and spatial distance while keeping the persona's head, face, and full body out of frame. When multiple other characters are present, frame them together whenever feasible within the persona's natural field of view, with their actions and relationships clearly readable. Do not exclude or distribute them across images merely because of their number.

Never substitute a similar registered character for an unmatched entity. Include every clearly present Actor together; do not distribute them across images depicting the same scene or merge casts from different times or places. Place required Interaction participants first, then every remaining confirmed Actor, registered or free. Lack of action, dialogue, or direct Interaction is not a reason to omit one.
